// Vendored snapshot. Do not edit — re-export instead.

{{RV|type=command

|game1= arma3
|version1= 1.22

|gr2= Math - Vectors

|descr= Dot product of two 3D vectors.<br>
{{Feature|GVI|arma3|2.14|Since {{GVI|arma3|2.14|size= 0.75}} any count of numbers is valid, but both arrays must be same length.<br>
Before {{GVI|arma3|2.14|size= 0.75}}, the first argument had to be vector 3D, or {{GVI|arma3|2.00|size= 0.75}} 2D (With z coordinate defaulted to 0)}} 


|s1= vector1 [[vectorDotProduct]] vector2

|p1= vector1: [[Array]] of [[Number]]s
|p2= vector2: [[Array]] of [[Number]]s

|r1= [[Number]]

|x1= <sqf>_dot = [1,0,1] vectorDotProduct [0,0,2];</sqf>

|seealso= [[vectorAdd]] [[vectorDiff]] [[vectorCrossProduct]] [[vectorCos]] [[vectorMagnitude]] [[vectorMagnitudeSqr]] [[vectorMultiply]] [[vectorDistance]] [[vectorDistanceSqr]] [[vectorDir]] [[vectorUp]] [[setVectorDir]] [[setVectorUp]] [[setVectorDirAndUp]] [[vectorNormalized]] [[vectorFromTo]] [[matrixMultiply]] [[matrixTranspose]]
}}

<dl class="command_description">

<dt></dt>
<dd class="notedate">Posted on 28 Jun, 2014</dd>
<dt class="note">[[User:ffur2007slx2_5| ffur2007slx2_5]]</dt>
<dd class="note">
{{GVI|arma3|1.22}} Algorithm:
<sqf>
Vector1 = [x1,y1,z1]; Vector2 = [x2,y2,z2];
Result = (x1 * x2) + (y1 * y2) + (z1 * z2);
</sqf>
It is recommended to use [[vectorDotProduct]] instead of [[BIS_fnc_dotProduct]].
</dl>
